questions.stem: A 60-year-old male presents to the emergency department with sudden onset severe chest pain radiating to his back. An urgent CT scan reveals an aortic dissection. As the medical team plans for urgent intervention, they discuss the structures passing through the aortic opening of the diaphragm to understand the potential complications and management of the patient's condition. The structure that passes through the aortic opening of the diaphragm is?
